title: A lost umbrella finds its way home
checked: Every reachable state checked (9 states, 11 with their data, 14 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 9 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
The office hands the umbrella over only to someone who can describe its duck handle.
rules.path: Take away the duck handle described guard and it breaks in 6 steps: next step, next step, next step, wait for nine, next step, ask for it.

rules.says: The counter opens at nine. Nobody is served before.
